summary: Compare each identity-fix candidate with the audited frame: is the identity fault gone, and did nothing else break?
logs: 18 panels: 9 accept, 9 retry, 0 keep old; 0 groups failed

items.notes: Varma now reads clearly as a different man from Nagoji: straight sleek jet-black hair combed back under the narrow white band, white namam with a red centre line, a pearl drop on the visible lobe, a waxed moustache with upturned points much lighter than Nagoji's handlebar, and a clean chin. Two small drifts. First, a short tail of straight hair hangs at his nape and ends in a slight wave. It reads as pulled-back hair, not curls, but the correction asked for no hair at the nape. Second, the moustache is a little heavier than the sheet's thinnest version, though clearly not bushy. The whole frame was lightly re-rendered and the doorway figures shifted by a few pixels. Faces, costumes, the map, the spear and the lamps are all unchanged. Nagoji's flush gold stud has nothing hanging from it, and Ibrahim and Ramayyan keep their faces.

On the king's cushion, the crown knot, the grey streak and the beard are gone. The figure now wears a cream-and-gold court turban with a jewelled peacock-feather crest, a pearl drop (a double pearl) and a clean jaw with a thin moustache tip in profile. Gold necklaces and a rudraksha string are added at the nape. NOTE: the small amount of hair showing below the turban at the nape is a dark, slightly tousled mass, and at high zoom it has a faint curl texture rather than reading as sleek. At print size, in the mid-ground, it reads only as dark hair under the turban, and the crest and pearl rule out any confusion with Nagoji. The optional recolour was applied: the attendee on the mat now wears a white turban, with his pose, curls and cloth kept. Nagoji is unchanged: rust-red turban, flush stud, thick moustache, crossed arms intact. The faint chin hatching the audit already called texture is still there. The departing figures, the women's cluster, the lamps and the sea are unchanged.

The stubble is gone from the chin, the underside of the chin and both jaws. At native size and in thumbnail the lower face reads clean-shaven, with only very faint low-contrast skin hatching visible at 5x zoom, plus the natural shadow under the lower lip. The skin on the face is slightly warmer and smoother than before, but the jaw shape, sideburns, moustache, eyes, turban, curls, the flat flush gold studs (nothing hanging) and the clothing are unchanged. So are the sea lights, the bluff and the ghosted cellar. The bare stretch of forearm above the screen-right hand shows no brand, the same as in the old frame.

items.new_faults: Varma now has TWO hair knots. Besides the small knot on the far (left) side of his head above the left temple, there is a second round bun tied with a gold band low at the back of his head, behind his visible right ear (frame around x 480 to 520, y 255 to 300). The bible allows exactly one knot, on the left side above the left ear, and never at the back.
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate, and only Varma's hair (seated on the dais, left of centre, face turned to the right). Remove the second, lower bun with its gold tie at the back of his head behind his visible right ear. In its place, paint straight, sleek jet-black hair combed smoothly back and down to the nape, with the sky and pillar showing behind as they do now. Keep exactly one knot: the small neat knot on the far (left) side of his head above the left temple and left ear. Keep it small and at the side, not on top of the crown. Keep everything else unchanged: his face and expression, the white namam with its red centre line, the thin waxed upturned moustache, the clean chin, the pearl drop earring, the necklaces, armlet and bangles, the pose and the spear, and the rest of the hall, including Ramayyan, the chiefs and Nagoji at the pillar.
items.notes: The diff shows the edit stayed on Varma's head; the rest is only re-encoding noise. His hair is now straight and sleek with no curls. He has the namam with a red centre line, a pearl drop on the visible ear and a clean chin. The moustache is thinner, with waxed upturned points, though slightly fuller at the centre than on the sheet. He no longer reads as a double of Nagoji. Nagoji (rust-red turban, clean chin, cream tunic, red sash, boots, talwar) and the chiefs are unchanged. There is no text and no broken hands.

items.remaining: The knot is still in the wrong place. The correction asked for no knot at the back and no gold band. On the sheet's left profile, the knot sits on the side of the head, inside the head outline, almost directly above the ear. Everything else in the fault is fixed: the hair is straight and sleek with no curls on the neck or shoulder, there is a white namam with a red centre line, the thin waxed moustache curls up at the tip, the chin is clean, and a pearl drop hangs from the visible left ear.
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate, and only Varma's hair knot (seated right, in left profile, handing over the ola). Move the knot off the upper back of his head, where it now sticks out past the back of the skull, and onto the side of the head: one small neat knot of sleek black hair, inside the head outline, directly above and only slightly behind his visible LEFT ear, as in the left-profile head on his model sheet. items.notes: Even with the knot placement still wrong, the new candidate is clearly better than the old one: Varma no longer reads as a double of Nagoji. Crops of Nagoji, Ramayyan and the two hands with the ola match the old frame. Outside Varma's head the diff is only re-encoding noise, and there is no text.

The stubble hatching on the chin and jaw and the grey patch under the lower lip are gone. What remains is a soft warm-brown shadow under the lip and the same faint painterly texture used on the rest of the skin. At print size it reads as clean-shaven. A few small spots on the upper cheek were smoothed slightly. This is minor and the face is not changed. The ear still has a single tiny flush gold stud with nothing hanging from it. The moustache, turban, curly hair, expression, smoke, campfire soldiers, sea and caption sky are unchanged, and the diff stays on the lower face.

At 14x zoom, Nagoji's right earlobe now carries one small gold stud at the bottom of the lobe, with plain jaw and neck skin below it. The separate teardrop is gone. The edit re-rendered the whole frame: the sky tones, the stone texture and the faint grey at his temple shift slightly, and the grey streak reads a touch stronger. Composition, De Lannoy's face and pose, the background Nair guards, the braziers, the bastions and the muzzle flash are all unchanged. The forearms (sleeves rolled, left forearm outer face only) show no brand, and the hands are intact.

items.remaining: The knot is still in the wrong place.
